visual.title: Multiplication rotates and scales
visual.caption: Drag z or w: the product's modulus is |z||w| and its argument is arg z + arg w, so multiplying by w rotates z by w's angle and scales it by w's length.

predict.question: If the modulus of w is 1, multiplying z by w does what?
options: Rotates z and leaves its length alone
Scales z and leaves its angle alone
Reflects z across the real axis
predict.explain: Multiplication adds arguments and multiplies moduli, so a unit modulus contributes only the rotation.
